Priya: NovaHealth wants SOC2 + ISO certs and a signed permissioned pen-test letter before POC. Also asked if Dedicated vs Private changes cost and whether customer-managed KMS is supported.

Omar: We can share cert PDFs via presigned link. Pen-test letter needs Security scope and Legal sign-off. Customer-managed KMS adds integration work (~2 business days).

Diana: Clarify deploy: Dedicated (fast, ~3 business days) or Private/on-prem (weeks). If they pick Dedicated but want KMS separation, add a one-time assurance/setup fee.

Priya: Suggest one-time assurance fee of $7,250 for Dedicated+KMS separation (covers KMS onboarding, isolation config, security review). Dedicated runtime pricing unchanged. Private is custom quote.

Omar: Draft pen-test template to hand to Legal (fill dates/CIDR once customer confirms).

AuditBot: uploaded artifacts: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-evidence/novah/2834506789/evidence.zip (expires in 7 days)

LegalBot: @Legal please review indemnity language; will sign after Security finalizes scope and we have insurer confirmation.

Priya: I'll send customer the artifact link, pen-test template, and the $7,250 assurance fee note. Ask them to confirm Dedicated vs Private and KMS preference by Fri COB.

Omar: Once they ack and pay assurance fee, Dedicated POC can be provisioned in ~3 business days.

Priya: Thanks team :thumbsup: will post customer reply here.
